title: Out-of-Hours Working Permit
name: Out-of-Hours Working Permit
description: Controls work outside normal site hours where reduced supervision, security, emergency response, access, noise and lone-working risks require specific authorisation.

sections.title: SUPERVISION AND PEOPLE
items: A named responsible person will remain in control for the full work period
The number and competence of people on site are suitable for the planned task
Lone working has been avoided or specifically assessed
Sign-in / sign-out and headcount arrangements are in place
Security / access staff know who is authorised to remain on site

sections.title: EMERGENCY AND SITE ARRANGEMENTS
items: Emergency contacts and escalation routes are available outside normal hours
First-aid and fire arrangements remain suitable
Welfare, lighting and safe access / egress remain available
Alarm, gate and security arrangements are understood
High-risk work has the separate specialist permit required for that activity
Noise, deliveries and neighbour / occupant impacts are controlled

sections.title: END OF SHIFT / SECURE SITE
items: Work is stopped at the approved time unless separately extended
Temporary services and equipment are left safe
Openings, scaffolds, excavations and restricted areas are secured
Fire systems, alarms, doors and gates are returned to the required state
All persons are accounted for before the responsible person leaves
